items.label: Jazz Pharmaceuticals 10-Q (08-03-2026)
items.signal_prefix: Jazz's 10-Q: Q2 2026 net income was $192.8 million

set.signal: Jazz's 10-Q: Q2 2026 net income was $192.8 million (Q2 2025: net loss of $(718.5) million, which included $905.4 million of acquired in-process R&D) and diluted EPS $2.78. Product sales, net were $1,156.1 million (+17%) and royalties and contract revenues $52.2 million (-13%); U.S. revenue was $1,077.9 million, Europe $97.4 million and all other $33.0 million. Six-month total revenues were $2,277.2 million (+17%), with Xywav $879.4 million (+16%), Epidiolex/Epidyolex $541.9 million (+15%), Zepzelca $206.8 million (+50%), Modeyso $89.6 million and Oncology $695.7 million (+38%). Purchases of property, plant and equipment in the first half were $37.8 million (2025: $26.8 million).
